title: "Program"

***
### 🏨 Venue Information
The main symposium is held at the **QT Hotel Perth** at 133 Murray Street in the heart of Perth CBD. Most sessions take place inside the **Murray Room**. The Murray Room is located on **Level 2** of the hotel.



**📍 Off-site Sessions **

**Workshop 3: Bioinformatics across AAGI: Automating Reproducible Bioinformatics Workflows** will be held in **Room Gallery** at **Curtin, 137 St Georges Terrace**. The venue is approximately 800 m, or a 10-minute walk, from the QT Hotel Perth.

The **Bioinformatics Satellite Meeting** will be held in **Room 212** at **Curtin Business School, 78 Murray Street**. The venue is approximately 160 m, or a 3-minute walk, from the QT Hotel Perth.

***
